title: Analysis: Huawei's Horinger data center, among China's largest for AI, has ~7% of the compute of SpaceX's Colossus 2 and may stay far behind until at least 2028 (Ben Cottier/Epoch AI)
summary: Ben Cottier / Epoch AI: Analysis: Huawei's Horinger data center, among China's largest for AI, has ~7% of the compute of SpaceX's Colossus 2 and may stay far behind until at least 2028 — This is a condensed version of a longer report on our website — Huawei, China's biggest AI chip developer, is drawing on China's abundant energy to build data centers.
